repair.title: Newborn Tetanus Fell
repair.summary: WHO estimates neonatal tetanus deaths fell by 88 percent from about 200,000 in 2000 to 24,000 in 2021.
repair.why_it_matters: Vaccination, clean delivery, and umbilical-cord care can prevent a disease that kills newborns in their first days.
repair.caveat: Several countries have not yet reached elimination status, and setbacks remain possible.
